# GUI Interface Description

## System Top Bar
- **Left Side**: "Activities" button
- **Center**: "Files" application title
- **Right Side**: 
  - Date and time: "Oct 23 00:46"
  - Notification bell icon
  - System status icons (network, sound, power)

## Desktop Environment
- **Background**: Abstract geometric wallpaper with gradient from deep purple to red-orange
- **Desktop Icon**: Single "Home" folder icon at bottom right corner

## Left Sidebar Navigation
- **Recent**: Section labeled "Recent"
- **Starred**: Section labeled "Starred"
- **Home**: Section labeled "Home" with house icon, currently selected
- **Standard Locations**:
  - Desktop
  - Documents
  - Downloads
  - Music
  - Pictures
  - Videos
  - Trash
- **Other Locations**: Section labeled "+ Other Locations"

## File Explorer Window
- **Title Bar**: "Home" with house icon
- **Navigation Controls**:
  - Back button (left arrow)
  - Forward button (right arrow)
- **Search Bar**: Placeholder text "Search" with magnifying glass icon
- **View Options**:
  - List view button (three horizontal lines)
  - View mode dropdown (downward arrow)
  - Grid view button (three horizontal lines)
- **Window Controls**:
  - Minimize button (dash)
  - Maximize button (square)
  - Close button (X)

## File and Folder Grid
- **Top Row**:
  - Desktop (folder icon with gradient)
  - Documents (folder icon with document)
  - Downloads (folder icon with download arrow)
  - Music (folder icon with musical note)
  - Pictures (folder icon with image)
  - Public (folder icon with share symbol)
  - requirement.txt (text file icon)
- **Second Row**:
  - server (folder icon)
  - snap (folder icon)
  - Templates (folder icon with document)
  - Videos (folder icon with video)
  - .bash_history (text file icon)
  - .bash_logout (text file icon)
  - .bashrc (text file icon)
- **Third Row**:
  - .cache (folder icon)
  - .config (folder icon)
  - .gnupg (folder icon)
  - .ipython (folder icon)
  - .lesshst (text file icon)
  - .local (folder icon)
  - .mozilla (folder icon)
- **Fourth Row**:
  - .pki (folder icon)
  - .profile (text file icon)
  - .selected_editor (text file icon)
  - .ssh (folder icon)
  - .sudo_as_admin_successful (text file icon)
  - thunderbird (folder icon)
  - .var (folder icon)
- **Fifth Row**:
  - .viminfo (text file icon)
  - .vscode (folder icon)

## Left Sidebar Icons (Application Launcher)
- **Top to Bottom**:
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - Files (File Manager)
  - Ubuntu Software
  - Help (Question Mark)
  - Trash (Recycle Bin)
  - Application Grid (Nine Dots)
